n: Autograph Edition 36 In. 21.6 Cu. Ft Counter-depth French Door Refrigerator With Water And Ice Dispenser In Fingerprint-resistant Black Stainless Steel With Champagne Bronze Traditional Handles
desc: The ZLINE Autograph Edition 36 in. 21.6 cu. ft Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator with Water and Ice Dispenser in Fingerprint-Resistant Black Stainless Steel with Champagne Bronze Traditional Handles (RFMZ-W-36-BS-CB) delivers an elevated experience by pairing innovative dual cooling technology with a spacious counter-depth design and an external water dispenser and ice maker. Achieve ZLINE Attainable Luxury® excellence with timeless features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability.
hl: Enjoy a timeless look in your kitchen with 4 luxurious Champagne Bronze traditional handles, giving your counter-depth refrigerator an elegant, unmatched style
Easily organize items with a 15.0 cu. ft. refrigeration compartment, a 4.0 cu. ft. freezer compartment and a 2.6 cu. ft. flex drawer—totaling 21.6 cu. ft. of storage capability
A specialty full-width flex drawer features 4 set temperature options between 30°F and 41°F, perfect for chilling wines, specialty meats, and other items for any occasion
Create the perfect cooling environment with fridge temperatures ranging from 34°F to 44°F and freezer temperatures ranging from -7°F to 7°F
Super Cool and Super Freeze Modes
Save time and quickly chill food with unique functions that automatically set the fridge temperature to 34°F and freezer to -7°F
External Water Dispenser and Ice Maker
Deliver fresh, filtered water discreetly from a sleek fridge door dispenser and up to 5 pounds of crushed or cubed ice per day with an automatic ice maker
spec: 1 year parts and service and 5 year parts on sealed system, including compressor, evaporator coil, condenser coil, filter drier
